queer.title: Queer
queer.description: This card has been changed. It keeps everything it was, and gains the effect listed on it. Queering a card again replaces that effect with a different one.
queer.poisoned.title: Queer: Poisoned
queer.poisoned.description: Applies 2 Poison to the enemy it hits.
queer.sharp.title: Queer: Sharp
queer.sharp.description: Deals 3 additional damage to the enemy it hits.
queer.loud.title: Queer: Loud
queer.loud.description: Applies 1 Weak to the enemy it hits.
queer.exposed.title: Queer: Exposed
queer.exposed.description: Applies 1 Vulnerable to the enemy it hits.
